routeHint: Settings (gear) -> Modules -> Users & Profiles -> Custom Fields, then click the pencil button on a choice-type field. The row expands into an inline editor and the selector crops to that card. The pencil is addressed through the row text ('T-Shirt Size', a dropdown field) rather than by index: the old '.button.is-small.is-rounded >> nth=2' never landed, so this shot came out byte-identical to custom-fields-list.
alt: Custom field editor showing the Title input, the Field type dropdown, the draggable option list, the Visibility selector set to Public, and the Save, Cancel and Remove buttons
note: Must be captured while signed in as an ADMIN_TENANT user: the encryption toggle only renders for ADMIN_TENANT and only on input/number/textarea/date fields. Ideal frame: a Dropdown or Checkboxes field so the draggable option list is visible, scrolled far enough to include the Visibility selector. If the encryption toggle is wanted in frame too, open an 'input' type field such as 'Troop Number' or 'Emergency Contact Phone' instead (options list will be absent), and update the alt text accordingly.
